C-INFRA-CI-LOC-METRICS-20260831.Summary: Add repository-owned LOC (lines of code) metrics collection and reporting to Worldline CI suites and workflows.
C-INFRA-CI-LOC-METRICS-20260831.Problem: The repository lacks automated lines of code measurement across crates, test suites, architecture contracts, and documentation in CI runs.

Goals.Goal: Implement scripts/ci/Get-WorldlineLoc.ps1 to calculate and report categorized LOC (Rust production, tests, WIT/fixtures, scripts, GRACE artifacts, documentation).
Integrate LOC reporting into the repository-owned Source CI suite.
Support GitHub Step Summary markdown export when running in GitHub Actions.
Update architecture guard and GRACE projections for M-CI-BASELINE.

Constraints.Constraint: LOC calculation logic is repository-owned, cross-platform PowerShell with zero external binary dependencies.
Execution produces identical results locally and in hosted GitHub Actions runners.
LOC measurement is integrated into repository scripts rather than isolated only in workflow YAML.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Enforcing arbitrary minimum or maximum LOC threshold gates.
Installing third-party external cloc/tokei binaries in CI runners.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: scripts/ci/Get-WorldlineLoc.ps1 calculates line statistics (total, code, comments, blanks) across all crates, tests, scripts, and docs.
Invoke-WorldlineCi.ps1 -Suite Source includes the LOC reporting step.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: LOC script executes locally and formats categorized code, test, and documentation line counts; CI suites run successfully with zero errors.

Assumptions.Assumption: PowerShell 7 (pwsh) is available on all supported runner platforms.
